entities.summary: Tsuki Amano , formerly Tsukiko Amano , is a Japanese singer, famous for singing the ending themes used in the Fatal Frame series: "Chō" for Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly, and "Koe" for Fatal Frame III: The Tormented, "Kurenai" for Project Zero 2: Wii Edition and "Torikago -in this cage-" for Fatal Frame: Maiden of Black Water. She also sang two songs for Fatal Frame: Mask of the Lunar Eclipse, "Zero no Chōritsu" and "Noise,".
